title: Grounded Support Assistant for Product and Returns Queries
raw_text: Beaumont Retail Holdings wants to reduce contact centre volume on product, returns, and store-policy questions that account for roughly 60 percent of inbound contacts. We require a conversational assistant grounded in our own product catalogue, returns policy, and care documentation, built on retrieval augmented generation over an approved corpus. The assistant must not answer from general knowledge: when the corpus does not support an answer it must say so and route to a human agent. Answers require source citations to the document and page used. Evaluation is against 500 historical queries with a hard accuracy floor agreed before build.
requirements: Retrieval augmented generation assistant over an approved internal corpus
Mandatory refusal and human handover when the corpus does not support an answer
Source citations to document and page for every answer
Evaluation against 500 historical queries against an agreed accuracy floor
